signature_formula: posterior mean per_cluster_mu_fg.T times TRAIN-cell-weighted mean batch detection_mean_y_e
installed_export_nuance: export_posterior multiplies by mean detection_y_c only when that site is in summaries; this installed module computes detection_y_c deterministically as obs2sample @ detection_mean_y_e and does not export it as a pyro.sample site. Project explicitly reconstructs that mean normalization; not an automatic library export. Matched convention in S31/S30. Raw latent signatures would differ by reported ~1% scalar, not an arbitrary truth calibration.
spatial_detection: detection_y_s is per-location with batch-level hypermean, not one fixed sample coefficient
technical_UMI: plug-in expectation from posterior means; not joint posterior expectation/interval
signature_stability: S30 stopped after its prespecified first250 epochs; no earlier signature checkpoint available, no claim of interstage signature stability
